scope: One matched direct Task06 Reviewer request to the already downloaded 27B Q5 model as the sole model server; private screen only

first_attempt.result: FAIL: oMLX aborted the request during prefill at its 22.8 GB hard watermark; finish_reason was absent, so HTTP 200 was not completion
first_attempt.host_pressure: normal sampled pressure, zero swap growth
first_attempt.settings_hazard: Starting a temporary omlx-cli serve with CLI flags changed the owner's global ~/.omlx/settings.json, including port, model directories, guard ceiling and cache mode. The normal KRYN owner restore refused that drift. The five changed values were restored from the installed profile and a private pre-repair copy; guarded bench and deep doctor then passed.

isolated_retry.isolation: HOME and HF_HOME were set to a private directory only for the temporary oMLX subprocess; owner stop/restore used the real environment
isolated_retry.owner_restore: PASS: temporary port closed; kryn bench passed and subsequent deep doctor verified healthy idle Qwen3.5-9B at 65,536 context, private 16 GiB guard, normal pressure and connected browser/search MCP

quality.diagnosis: Correctly identified JSON serialization as the cause of the exact-literal stored-markup failure and retained an inert textContent sink.
quality.proposed_repair: The proposed map handled strings and objects with a text property, then fell back to JSON.stringify(row). Actual API rows are objects with id, project, minutes and date; the fallback preserved JSON-escaped quotes.
quality.independent_browser: FAIL: a disposable application of the exact proposal passed inert markup, then failed the strict literal-text check: stored text still had JSON-escaped double quotes.

decision: Do not promote Q5. One 16K request completed under the observed host load at a 27 GiB process guard, but the matched source-bound repair failed. The 24 GiB guard was insufficient, and 64K/sustained agent quality and resource safety remain unqualified. Keep the existing guarded private 9B/64K owner profile and rollback.
limits: One direct request is not a 49K–128K tier benchmark, an autonomous coding/UI task, repeated compaction/restart, or 45–60 minutes of green endurance. Sampled memory peaks can miss transients. No public release, tag or version bump was made.
